local_environments.create:
CREATE TABLE local_environments (
	owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	installation_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	preferred_language VARCHAR(80), 
	timezone VARCHAR(80), 
	environment_revision INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	timezone_revision INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	confirmed_at DATETIME, 
	lease_client_id VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_token_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_session_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_expires_at DATETIME, 
	lease_sequence INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (owner_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

environment_timezone_changes.create:
CREATE TABLE environment_timezone_changes (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	previous_timezone VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	timezone VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	effective_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_environment_zone_revision UNIQUE (owner_id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
